'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
